scope:
Couple the dual core prefix to an actual nonlinear finite tail D-N map.

All root_dual_core_bvp.py arguments remain available. --tail-config supplies
the actual tail discretization. Each true tail request uses the complete
represented cut height. The outer algorithm solves the nonlinear prefix
against an affine tail tangent, then accepts only after a new solve of
the original nonlinear tail confirms its physical boundary residual.
The nested option requests the true tail at each boundary evaluation.
Mean and second jets are measured separately. This finite joined
problem is not an infinite tail, a cap, or a complete closed surface.

staged_response_recovery.scope:
Accept a saved affine-inner prefix only after an independently saved true DN.

The complete audited tail packet must match the exact raw cut height, all
equations/discretization, and every loaded tail source hash. Original raw
identity checks run unchanged. Collocation RMS is recomputed from the saved
cubic, and the original inlet and unscaled physical true-DN gates are tested.
Only then is the pending state passed to the original physical interpolant
and audits. This records a genuine staged evaluation of the original finite
problem; it asserts neither exact isometry nor infinite closure.

frozenCalibrationAdapter.name: frozen-binary-calibration-lookup-v1
frozenCalibrationAdapter.scope: Saved binary alpha_n only for n<160. All original source cells, far transfers, graphs, physical quadrature and arithmetic order are retained. Global warp alpha is the saved binary datum. No recalibration, truncated head, new deep metric or nonlinear solution.

storedMetricAdapter.scope: The saved original binary alpha_n and global warp alpha are reused through a source-hash-locked lookup. All original physical formulas, arithmetic order, 160 cells and auxiliary far transfers remain; five- and seven-fraction historical fingerprints are checked. No rational deep replacement or physical recalibration.

stableGraphAdapter.name: tail-original-stored-shared-stable-graphs-v1
stableGraphAdapter.scope: Original stored metric and shared stable graph arithmetic. An already accepted trial is copied to the existing recovery-only progress recorder before the next variational pass. The pass, solve tolerance, positivity guard, line search and success definition remain unchanged.

seam_nonmean.scope: Physical PPoly derivatives versus actual finite-tail jets. Height means and Cartesian frame closure remain separate.

bounded_actual_coupling.scope:
Run the unchanged actual finite-tail coupling with bounded storage.

The original stored tail metric, complete physical height boundary vector,
nonlinear tail checks and physical acceptance remain in force. Independent
radial batches and the verified block QR solve the same prefix Jacobian.
The bounded tail client retains the original profile and full mean. This is
an actual finite joined problem, not an exact infinite closed surface. The
prefix normally retains its physical design controls. With an explicit
--fixed-reference, the existing actual fixed-metric adapter instead freezes
the complete physical data and solves all core coefficients as boundary data.
Optional --geometric-flow-cache-size (default 0) uses the independently
checked exact-constructor cache for the prefix; it never caches tail solves.
The explicit --client stored-resumable option additionally saves accepted
tail trials for recovery. It preserves the same solve and acceptance gates;
the default remains stored-bounded. A recovery trial is not a final response.
